screen.wateroptimisation.title: Water Optimisation
screen.wateroptimisation.description: Only changes how water is drawn on your computer. It does not change gameplay, your world, or the server.
screen.wateroptimisation.advanced.title: Water Optimisation — Advanced
screen.wateroptimisation.advanced.descri: Want better performance? Start with Performance. Hidden-water skipping is conservative; inward-face reduction is experimental and may change underwater views.
screen.wateroptimisation.sodium_notice: Sodium renders water geometry itself, so water-geometry options are unavailable. Particle settings still apply.
screen.wateroptimisation.culling.tooltip: The hidden-water option skips only fully hidden source-water blocks. Experimental mode also reduces inward faces and may cause visual and graphical issues.
screen.wateroptimisation.culling_sodium_: Water rendering mode? Unavailable while Sodium renders water
screen.wateroptimisation.culling_unavail: Water rendering mode? Experimental reduced inward faces unavailable on this version
screen.wateroptimisation.fast_path.toolt: Skips only fully hidden source-water blocks. Visible, flowing, waterlogged, transparent, and unusual water stays vanilla.
screen.wateroptimisation.fast_path_unava: Skip hidden water blocks? Unavailable while Sodium renders water
screen.wateroptimisation.forced_particle: Limit water particles that ignore distance? %s
wateroptimisation.path.vanilla_particles: Vanilla water geometry with local particle filtering
wateroptimisation.path.hidden_compile: Vanilla water geometry with hidden-water compile skipping
wateroptimisation.path.reduced_faces: Vanilla water geometry with reduced inward faces
wateroptimisation.path.sodium_particles: Sodium water geometry with local particle filtering
